revives.note: XM's design, never frozen; its fit settings are kept unchanged

build.note: the modules commit (modules main) and each module's wasm SHA-256; every wasm is read with git show at that commit, never from a working tree

period.cutoff: 00:00 UTC of every day of the period
period.why: C2 holds out every calibration object from cutoff 2026-06-01 on (integrity cut 2); one period for every group

X0.label: SGP4XP native: Jacchia 1970 on the generic flux model

X2.label: SGP4XP with NRLMSISE-00 on as-issued $SPW rows (the candidate)

X3.label: X2 times the open-DCA common mode (secondary candidate)

P.label: the public Space-Track set under the console's SGP4
P.propagator: propagator/sgp4 propagate_ephemeris (foundation/sgp4-str3, AFSPC mode), TEME, 300 s
P.selection: experiments/e4-operator-ephemeris-parity products.mjs setAt: the newest set by EPOCH with EPOCH and CREATION_DATE at or before the cutoff

dragPrior.note: $PCF FIT.DRAG_PRIOR: MEAN the median of BTERM (m2/kg), SIGMA the standard deviation of ln BTERM (ln 10)

srpPrior.note: AGOM held at 0.01 m2/kg: a prior sigma under one unit of the lattice digit is not stepped

fit.otherFit: every other FIT field at its $PCF default
fit.arc: the truth's states in [cutoff - arc, cutoff], USEABLE_START_TIME the first, USEABLE_STOP_TIME the cutoff, REFERENCE_FRAME GCRF
fit.epoch: the arc's first state (the module's placement)
fit.thinRule: every round(300 / step)-th state of the arc on the product's own grid (G1 lib/baselines.mjs)
fit.coverage: the arc's states over (arc hours x 3600 / the product's step); below 0.9 the arc is not fitted and the window leaves that arc's cells, counted

O.rows: experiments/xp-atmosphere-merit/lib/weather.mjs rowsO: the most recent RSGA issued at or before the cutoff (at most 72 h old) with GFZ observed F10.7 and definitive Ap before it, the trailing 81-day mean, the last row held (HOLD_LAST); no RSGA in force: the window is excluded from O and counted
O.dcl: the open-DCA nowcast issued at the cutoff

M.rows: lib/weather.mjs rowsM: observed F10.7 (DRAO, GFZ file) and GFZ definitive Ap through the horizon, the true centered 81-day mean
M.dcl: the hindcast: the same solver issued at cutoff + 174 h (7 d + the 6 h latency), every arc through the day-7 horizon

dca.license: derived aggregate of Planet Labs PBC ephemerides, CC BY-NC 4.0; Planet states and arcs stay local

GN.name: GNSS MEO (control)
GN.control: above the drag-free altitude X2 and X3 equal X0 bit for bit: every propagated coordinate of every scored epoch; a difference is a software defect and stops the run

outOfScope.TerraSAR-X 31698: C2 holds it out by object (cut 1)
outOfScope.Sentinel-1D 66315: C2 holds it out by object (cut 1)
outOfScope.ISS 25544: C2 holds the ISS out for 2025-01-01..2026-10-31 (cut 3)
outOfScope.laser-ranged spheres: XM's window 2026-07-16..08-30 is C2's type-L hold-out and after 2026-06-01 (cuts 2 and 4)

integrity.source: experiments/ffm-covariance-calibration/config.json split.heldOutObject; PLAN.md:143; Galileo x6 by P9 (results/ffm-covariance-calibration/precheck-P9.json sample: 43567 37847 41862 41174 43055 41175)

integrity.source: experiments/ffm-covariance-calibration/PLAN.md:144 (held out by time: calibration objects, cutoff dates E from 2026-06-01); config split.heldOutTime

GPCV P0: no Swarm or GRACE-FO truth for 10-31..11-28

integrity.rule: never read: C2 held-out row files, B2 part 1a and part 5 files, propagator-catalog-census results, operator-capture cycle content

public.fields: MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4 and EPHEMERIS_TYPE 0 only; the values as published
public.license: Space-Track.org GP data (USSPACECOM / 18 SDS): local only, results are aggregates

scoring.grid: the truth's epochs in (cutoff, cutoff + 7 d] whose offset from the first of them is a whole multiple of 300 s
scoring.bin: lead day k: (cutoff + (k - 1) d, cutoff + k d]
scoring.binRule: a bin enters when the truth holds at least 260 of its 288 grid epochs (90 %), decided by the truth alone
scoring.metric: e: the 3D RMS position error of the bin (km) in the truth's RTN axes; the along-track RMS beside it
scoring.scorer: G1 lib/baselines.mjs rtnSeries (analysis/gp-error-model pair_statistics); predictions in TEME to GCRF by foundation/frames, every arm alike
scoring.nonFinite: an arm with a non-finite state at a scored epoch fails

statistics.pairs: per group, arc, condition, contrast and lead: the windows whose bin entered and whose reference arm was attempted (P: a set at or before the cutoff)
statistics.d: ln(e_arm / e_ref); arm failed: +Infinity (its loss, never dropped); else reference failed: -Infinity
statistics.p95: ln(p95 of e_arm / p95 of e_ref), a failed arm's e = +Infinity

bootstrap.unit: orbit group x ISO week of the cutoff
bootstrap.generator: xorshift128+ seeded by SHA-256 (XA run.mjs generator)

clusters.primary: orbit group (config groups.*.objects.cluster) x ISO week

statistics.nan: a NaN statistic counts as +Infinity (against the arm)

primary.question: does X2 beat P
primary.cells: arc 72 h, condition O, orbit-group clusters, leads 1, 2, 3 and 7
primary.rule: X2 beats P in a group only if every lead cell meets all three: (1) the 95 % interval of the median d lies wholly below 0; (2) the upper bound of the 95 % interval of ln(p95_X2 / p95_P) is below ln 1.10; (3) X2 fails on at most 1 % of the pairs

secondary: X2 against X0 by the same rule, drag groups (P, S1) only: the atmosphere's own effect
X3 against P and X3 against X0 by the same rule (X0: drag groups only)
verdict.control: GN: X2 and X3 equal X0 bit for bit in every GN window

check.rule: each pinned window re-run and every stored number compared exactly (===); the table rebuilt from the stored rows equal to the committed table.json byte for byte
